description: This file contains unit tests for ELF relocations, specifically testing the application of various relocation types on a simulated memory buffer, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: RelocationsTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing ELF relocations application logic.

methods.name: RelocationsTest
methods.description: Constructor initializing test buffer, dynamic section, and relocations object.

methods.name: VerifySymAddress
methods.description: Verifies that the relocation target contains the expected symbol address.

methods.name: VerifySymAddressPlusAddend
methods.description: Verifies that the relocation target contains symbol address plus addend (used in RELA).

methods.name: VerifyBaseAddressPlusAddend
methods.description: Verifies that the relocation target contains base address plus addend (used in RELA).

methods.name: VerifySymAddressPlusAddendDelta
methods.description: Verifies that the relocation target contains symbol address plus addend minus offset (used in RELA).
